headline: How a US$23 Billion Buyback Authorization at Phillips 66 (PSX) Has Changed Its Investment Story
summary: On July 31, 2026, Phillips 66 announced that its board approved a US$10.00 billion increase to the share repurchase authorization, lifting the total buyback capacity to US$23.00 billion as the prior program neared its limit. This enlarged buyback pool underscores management’s emphasis on returning capital to investors alongside dividends, capital investment, and debt reduction within its broader energy manufacturing and logistics operations.
